title: Scalar compatibility of the inverse-image change-of-rings unit
statement: Let f:X→Y be a continuous map, A a sheaf of commutative rings on Y, B one on X, t:f⁻¹A→B, and G an A-module sheaf. For every open V of Y, c∈A(V), and n∈G(V), write W=f⁻¹V, eta and etaR for the additive and ring inverse-image units, and sh for the B-linear sheafification unit of sectionwise extension along t. Then t_W(etaR(c)) • sh(1 tensor eta(n)) = sh(1 tensor eta(c • n)). Inverse image and its module action are those of [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module]; the extension tensor and sheafification are those of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

proof.text: Use the semilinearity clause of Classical.choose_spec (exists_inverseImageModuleInstances f A G) for the actual canonical inverse-image section instances. Pull the target-ring scalar through the linear sheafification unit. ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.smul_tmul computes the target action; TensorProduct.tmul_smul and TensorProduct.smul_tmul' balance the inverse-image scalar between the two factors. The restricted scalar action is multiplication by t(r), and mul_one finishes.

theorem inverseImage_changeOfRings_unit_smul
    {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (A : Y.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u})
    (B : X.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (t : TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f A ⟶ B)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj A))
    (V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)ᵒᵖ) (c : A.obj.obj V) (n : G.val.obj V) :
    let W := (Opens.map f).op.obj V
    let eta := ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
      (Opens.map f) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj G)).hom.app V
    let etaR := ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
      (Opens.map f) CommRingCat.{u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app A).hom.app V
    let sh := ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj B).obj)).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t
            (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule f A G))).app W
    (t.hom.app W).hom (etaR c) •
      sh ((1 : B.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[(TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f A).obj.obj W,
        (t.hom.app W).hom] eta n) =
      sh ((1 : B.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[(TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f A).obj.obj W,
        (t.hom.app W).hom] eta (c • n))
